coordinate_system.unit: percent of canvas width for x/width; percent of canvas height for y/height
coordinate_system.text_boxes: logical layout boxes, with explicit line breaks and centered vertical alignment

immutable_assets.posters: All five source JPGs are used intact. Their embedded lettering, symbols and textures are atomic parts of each poster element, not separately recreated.
immutable_assets.symbols: Original supplied RGBA files, shape and color unchanged.

reproduction.draw_order: elements array order, except line and text elements need no extra background; original poster shadows and blank paper are already baked into B.
reproduction.images: fit contain, preserve aspect ratio, no distortion; use original alpha for symbols
reproduction.text_engine: Pillow FreeType with supplied Google Fonts files, weight axis explicitly set
reproduction.A_files: High quality JPEG visual previews. B files are lossless PNG. JPEG compression means A is not intended as a pixel-difference test target.

pair_template.ordering: English alphabetical sign order; for same-sign pairs preserve left/right name labels.
replacement_rules: Keep layout boxes unchanged. Fit each original symbol inside its allocated maximum box without stretching.
Use optical scale adjustments within the box only; preserve every symbol shape.
For longer pair names, reduce only that label font size by up to 15 percent, then use a deliberate two-line label if required.
Change preview names and date only by supplying a newly prepared original poster; do not paint over the supplied poster.

card_proxy_note: The supplied package contains 4:5 posters but no 5:7 card artwork. A card previews preserve the complete source poster and contain it inside a 5:7 card with neutral top/bottom margins. Replace the card asset with the approved 5:7 design for publication. No poster stretching or cropping has been used.
alternative_wording_note: Our First Year and Always us are shown as typography examples outside the unchanged poster on slide 04. Apply these through the existing poster personalization system, not by redrawing supplied artwork.
generated_scene_note: Only the stone and wood scene backgrounds are generated with the built-in image tool. Native files are 1448x1086 and included. They are resampled to 3200x2400; typography and overlays render natively at final size. Scene props are illustrative, not a photograph of an actual fulfilled product.
